title: Telephone-Fee Basis Schedule — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
Schedule of the telephone-fee basis for a call-center redemption of a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers. The basis is set from the value the credit paid toward the ticket of that redemption. That value is the total of the credit's redemption entries for that ticket.

| Value the credit paid toward the ticket (USD) | Telephone-fee basis |
|---|---|
| below 100.00 | 12 percent of that value |
| 100.00 to below 250.00 | the lesser of the instrument's telephone redemption fee and 16 percent of that value |
| 250.00 and above | the instrument's telephone redemption fee, the flat fee per ticket |

**Schedule rule.** The telephone-fee basis is 12 percent of the value the credit paid toward that ticket when that value is below 100 US dollars. It is the lesser of the instrument's telephone redemption fee and 16 percent of that value when the value is at least 100 but below 250 US dollars. It is the instrument's telephone redemption fee when the value is at least 250 US dollars.

## Specimen values (hypothetical instrument whose telephone redemption fee is 25 US dollars)

| Value paid toward the ticket | Working | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| 80.00 | 12 percent of 80.00 | 9.60 |
| 100.00 | lesser of 25.00 and 16 percent of 100.00, which is 16.00 | 16.00 |
| 150.00 | lesser of 25.00 and 16 percent of 150.00, which is 24.00 | 24.00 |
| 200.00 | lesser of 25.00 and 16 percent of 200.00, which is 32.00 | 25.00 |
| 250.00 | the instrument's telephone redemption fee | 25.00 |

Where the credit paid toward the same ticket in more than one redemption entry, the value is their total.
